registration_timing: Registered after the independent H6R observation-density effect was replicated, but before generation or fitting of replicates 221 through 240.
purpose: Separate response-density loss from latent ability-by-rater-severity assignment dependence while holding sparse-design row counts, rater exposure, category support, and structural connectivity fixed.

data_generating_process.person_distribution: normal standardized within replicate to realized mean 0 and population SD 0.8
data_generating_process.common_random_numbers: All three observation designs are subsets of the same complete response matrix within replicate. Assignment masks use Theta and identifiers but never realized scores.

planned_connected.rule: Existing Person-index adjacent Rater ring: R01-R02, R02-R03, R03-R04, R04-R01 repeating independently of generated Theta.

ability_severity_aligned_connected.ability_quartile_rule: Stable sort by generated Theta, tie-break by Person identifier, exactly 20 Persons per quartile.
ability_severity_aligned_connected.role: latent ability-dependent assignment stressor; not an identified real-data missingness model

estimation_layers.purpose: same-estimand external calibration plus Python screening evidence

estimation_layers.estimand: normal-person marginal likelihood with SD fixed at 0.8
normal-person marginal likelihood with SD estimated

screening_outputs.primary_descriptive_contrast: ability_severity_aligned_connected minus planned_connected within replicate and estimator mode
screening_outputs.interval: two-sided Student t screening interval over 20 paired contrasts
screening_outputs.multiplicity: No inferential promotion. All intervals are descriptive screening signals.
screening_outputs.method_comparison_rule: Report within-estimator design contrasts. Do not rank estimators or compare likelihood/AIC across joint, marginal, and conditional bases.

operational_contract.facets_retry: At most two retries only for exit-0/missing named report.
operational_contract.facets_serialization: Shared cross-process lock and short retained work roots.

stop_rules: Stop before fitting if row counts, rater exposure, connectivity, constrained PCM nullity, quartile sizes, or shared-response hashes fail.
Retain and report every estimator and FACETS failure in the planned denominator.
Do not impute, replace, or silently rerun a completed statistical attempt.
Do not interpret FACETS Subset connection O.K. as a substitute for the independent constrained-design rank audit.
Do not reconstruct raw fit statistics from FACETS two-decimal displays.
Do not select a confirmatory endpoint or direction until all 20 screening replicates are complete and reported.
claim_limit: This screening can identify candidate sensitivity to one deliberately constructed latent ability-by-severity assignment mechanism under a correctly specified PCM. It cannot identify an empirical missingness mechanism, establish MAR/MNAR correction, prove universal bias, or rank JMLE, MML, and CMLE.
